statement: Bodily homeostasis and Daisyworld temperature regulation share the negative-feedback structure (analogy only).
test: Compare loop structure (sensor/comparator/effector) and stability margins in both models.
rejection_criterion: Rejected as more than analogy if Earth-system feedbacks lack a regulated set point or net-amplify perturbations (C0v2-R6-08).
gaia_thread: The body's self-regulation is the nearest-scale image of regulation within Earth's living whole.

statement: Physiological homeostasis is an evolved, selected regulation of an organism; planetary regulation (if any) has no comparable selection mechanism.
test: Check whether any proposed Gaian mechanism involves selection at planetary scale.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if a demonstrated planetary-scale selection mechanism is published and replicated.
gaia_thread: Keeps science separate from the motherthread metaphor.

statement: Human thermoregulation balances heat exchange with the environment; human bodies are therefore continuously coupled to Earth's thermal environment.
test: Measure heat-balance terms (radiation, convection, evaporation) under varied ambient conditions.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if core temperature were independent of ambient exchange (it is not, per source).
gaia_thread: The body is one node in Earth's energy flows.

statement: Mental processes depend on the nervous system (CNS/PNS) and on sensory transduction for input.
test: Lesion/stimulation studies: altering nervous tissue alters cognition.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if cognition were shown unaffected by nervous-system damage across cases.
gaia_thread: Mind arises within a living body that belongs to Earth's living whole.

statement: Interoception: bodily signals shape feeling and cognition, and cognition (anticipation) shapes bodily regulation (allostasis).
test: Intervene on interoceptive accuracy or anticipatory cues and measure both affect and physiology.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if manipulating one side has no measurable effect on the other.
gaia_thread: Loops within the person mirror loops between organism and environment.

statement: Embodied cognition: body constitutes vs merely causes cognition.
test: Look for cases discriminating constitution from causal contribution (coupling–constitution debate).
rejection_criterion: Constitutive reading rejected if all embodied effects are captured by causal-input models.
gaia_thread: Whether mind is 'in' the body–world system is the motherthread question at personal scale.

statement: Predictive-processing accounts of perception and learning (prediction error) are also candidate theories of consciousness.
test: Derive distinct predictions for conscious vs unconscious prediction-error processing.
rejection_criterion: Rejected for consciousness if prediction-error signatures are identical for conscious and unconscious contents.
gaia_thread: Prediction links organism and world, a thread of the living whole.

statement: Access (reportable) processing is distinct from phenomenal experience; cognitive findings bear on access more directly.
test: Conceptual analysis plus no-report paradigms.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if the concepts are shown to be co-extensional by all accepted measures.
gaia_thread: Keeps what is measured separate from what is meant.

statement: Personal identity as psychological continuity, as organism (animalism), or as soul.
test: Thought experiments (fission, too-many-thinkers) and coherence analysis; no empirical test decides.
rejection_criterion: A view is rejected only by internal incoherence; none is so rejected here.
gaia_thread: Identity of the person within the living whole is unresolved.

statement: Across traditions, soul and spirit share a breath/life vocabulary (psuchê/pneuma, nefesh/rûaḥ, rūḥ, qi).
test: Lexical/textual survey across primary texts.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if the breath/life sense were absent from the cited texts (it is present).
gaia_thread: Breath is the traditions' own image of life shared with the world.

statement: Traditions distinguish soul (individual identity, moral character) from spirit (vitality, connection, inspiration) differently; there is no single cross-tradition boundary.
test: Extend coding (SIM-R3) with spirit attributes and test cluster stability.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if a stable cross-tradition partition emerges robustly (it did not in v2).
gaia_thread: The motherthread does not erase the traditions' differences.

statement: Is the subject of experience a soul, a brain process, or neither? (dualism vs physicalism vs other).
test: No decisive empirical test known; adversarial theory tests narrow the field of physicalist theories only.
rejection_criterion: Not rejectable with current methods; recorded as unresolved.
gaia_thread: Open question at the heart of the synthesis.

statement: Several traditions extend soul or personhood beyond humans (Greek ensouled plants; animist non-human persons).
test: Textual/ethnographic survey.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if the cited sources did not report this (they do).
gaia_thread: Personhood extended to the living world is a traditional form of the motherthread.

statement: Religious attendance is associated with lower mortality and spirituality with better mental health on average.
test: Prospective cohorts with negative controls; sibling/fixed-effects designs.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if associations vanish after control for health selection or reverse causation.
gaia_thread: Connection to community is a measurable thread of human flourishing.

statement: The association is causal (participation lowers mortality).
test: Designs robust to confounding (instrumental variables, natural experiments).
rejection_criterion: Rejected if a measured confounder of strength ≥ E (≈1.97 both ways) is found that removes the association.
gaia_thread: Kept hypothetical; the motherthread does not upgrade it.

statement: Spiritual interpretation (vitality, transcendence) is separate from the demonstrable well-being associations.
test: Check each well-being claim for measurement contamination.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if spirituality measures were shown free of mental-health items (contested).
gaia_thread: Framework rule applied.

statement: Level of consciousness tracks measurable brain-state complexity (PCI) across sleep, anaesthesia and injury.
test: Replicate PCI thresholds in new cohorts.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if PCI fails to discriminate conscious from unconscious states in independent samples.
gaia_thread: Awareness rides on living bodily processes.

statement: Altered states (psychedelic, mystical) may share neural signatures such as elevated entropy.
test: Compare entropy measures across psychedelic, meditative and reported mystical states.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if entropy measures do not differ or do not track reports.
gaia_thread: Transcendence reports and brain dynamics remain separate until tested.

statement: The geodynamo depends on core heat flow (cooling, inner-core freezing, chemical convection).
test: Dynamo models constrained by CMB heat-flux estimates and paleomagnetism.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if a sustained field were found without core convection (none known).
gaia_thread: The 'heart' image maps onto real heat flow — physics, not metaphor.

statement: Life and biogeochemical cycles co-evolved: microbial metabolism drives element cycles that in turn shape habitats.
test: Isotope and genomic records of metabolic evolution vs cycle changes.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if core metabolic genes and cycles were shown independent.
gaia_thread: Life as a planetary process — the scientific content nearest the motherthread.

statement: Is Earth's biota a homeostatic regulator (strong Gaia) or do biotic feedbacks often amplify change?
test: Quantify net sign of biotic climate feedbacks in paleo and model records.
rejection_criterion: Strong Gaia rejected if net biotic feedbacks are amplifying across major perturbations.
gaia_thread: The motherthread is a framing; whether Earth regulates itself is a separate empirical question.

statement: Humans are drivers within Earth's living systems: transgressing climate or biosphere-integrity boundaries could shift the Earth system's state; ~1 million species are threatened.
test: Track boundary indicators and extinction rates.
rejection_criterion: Rejected if indicators show no human signal (they do, per sources).
gaia_thread: The clearest evidence that human life is inside, not outside, the living whole.

statement: Life as Earth's soul and the core as its heart: metaphor vs literal claim.
test: No scientific test of planetary consciousness is specified.
rejection_criterion: Any literal reading is rejected for lack of evidence; the metaphor stands as metaphor.
gaia_thread: The motherthread itself — labelled Philosophical/Spiritual.

statement: Consciousness's nature, the soul's existence, spirituality's causal role, geodynamo onset, Singularity/Origin remain open.
test: Each item has its own test listed in its source report.
gaia_thread: What the motherthread cannot yet tie is recorded, not hidden.
